newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Tension has not ended among protesting Jiu Valley miners. Thousands of miners continued their protests in Petrosani, awaiting the decisions of the strike committee.
* Miners from other regions on Thursday annunced their support for the protesting Jiu Valley coal miners.

* Romania will continue to lobby for admission to Euro- Atlantic structures no matter the decision that will be adopted at the alliance's Madrid summit in July, Defence Minister Victor Babiuc told a news conference.
